clue.text: None may enter here so to speak

clue.text: Drink could be the reverse of OK

explanation.surface: A beverage might be unwholesome or simply not all right.

explanation.walkthrough: Husky looks like hoarse; here it means made of husks.

explanation.definitionFit: Titration is the laboratory method of finding a solution's strength by careful addition of a reagent.

clue.text: Charge a broadcaster going by river

clue.text: Prolong out of mind

clue.text: He's allowed to enter the odd heat

clue.text: Cooked sausage may so allay the pangs of hunger

blocks.note: taken as written

clue.text: Tuck in this dress for riding
